personnelNotes: The office runs six divisions and each charter page is badged with the one that owns the service: Administrative, Zoning, Housing and Homesite Regulation (HHRD), Plans and Programs (PPD), Special Projects (SPD) and Research and Statistics (RESD).

The charter names a Zoning Officer II as Ar. Jessica O. Rañeses and a Research and Statistics PEO III as Jessica R. Rañeses. Whether these are two people or one name spelled two ways has not been confirmed, so both are listed as printed.
The City Mayor appears in the responsible-person column of three services as the approving authority. He is not CPDO staff and so is named by office rather than listed here.

feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Call 742-0821, email legazpicpdo@gmail.com, or fill up the Feedback Form. Clients are given a form for each service they use. The office is on the 2nd floor of the City Hall building.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: The assigned officer collects the forms at the end of the transaction day and submits them to the Administrative Officer for recording. They are collated quarterly and averaged into the rating clients gave for each service, presented as the Client Satisfaction Measurement Report, then submitted to the City Human Resource Management Office for the Harmonized CSM Report that goes to the Anti-Red Tape Authority. Complaints may be filed in writing or in person: write to the City Planning and Development Coordinator, email jocelyncodorniz29@gmail.com, or call or text 0919-841-3056. The head of office asks the officer concerned to verify the complaint, then acts on it as a light or grave offence depending on what was done, with the City Human Resource Management Office applying sanctions where it assists. A client who asks for the action in writing is given it.

steps.client: Submit the required documents to CPDO-HHRD.
steps.agency: If the application meets all the requirements it is officially received. If it is incomplete or has deficiencies, HHRD staff issue a notice of deficiency and re-evaluate what you resubmit. HHRD then endorses the application to the City Legal Office and the City Engineer's Office for comments and recommendations; if it comes back with findings, the deficiencies are sent to you for compliance. HHRD conducts an ocular inspection, prepares an inspection report, endorses findings to you if anything needs clarifying, then prepares an endorsement letter to the City Mayor's Office for endorsement to the Sangguniang Panlungsod. HHRD staff attend the SP committee hearing and recommend approval. On receiving the SP resolution approving the application, HHRD issues the order of payment and prepares the marking of the plan for the signature of the CPDC and the City Mayor. The City Mayor's Office endorses the approved PALC to CPDO and HHRD tells you it is ready to claim.
steps.personResponsible: City Mayor / CPDC / HHRO V / HHRO II / Draftswoman I
